import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler

# Dataset to be scaled to different ranges
data = {
    'sensor_reading': [0.1, 0.5, 0.3, 0.8, 0.2, 0.9, 0.4, 0.7],
    'confidence': [0.01, 0.95, 0.50, 0.75, 0.30, 0.88, 0.15, 0.60]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Scale sensor_reading to [0, 100] range
scaler_100 = MinMaxScaler(feature_range=(0, 100))
df['sensor_scaled'] = scaler_100.fit_transform(df[['sensor_reading']])

# Scale confidence to [-1, 1] range
scaler_neg1_1 = MinMaxScaler(feature_range=(-1, 1))
df['confidence_scaled'] = scaler_neg1_1.fit_transform(df[['confidence']])

# Verify the scaled values fall within the target ranges
print(f"Sensor range: [{df['sensor_scaled'].min():.1f}, {df['sensor_scaled'].max():.1f}]")
print(f"Confidence range: [{df['confidence_scaled'].min():.2f}, {df['confidence_scaled'].max():.2f}]")

# Print original and scaled dataframes
print("\nOriginal and Scaled Data:")
print(df)
